title: Frontend Engineer
description: We are hiring a Frontend Engineer to build fast, accessible React and Next.js interfaces. You will own features end to end, from component design to performance and testing. Strong TypeScript, CSS, and a habit of shipping small, well-tested changes are essential. Bonus: experience with design systems and real-time media.

title: Backend Engineer (Python)
description: We are looking for a Backend Engineer to design and operate Python services with FastAPI. You will work on APIs, background jobs, and third-party integrations, and care about reliability, observability, and clear data models. Experience with async Python and cloud deployment is a plus.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Join us to build speech and language systems for real-time conversations. You will evaluate and integrate LLMs, speech-to-text, and text-to-speech models, and improve latency and quality in production. Solid understanding of model evaluation, prompt design, and Python is required.
